parent_header_and_attachment_link_rechec: 2026-10-31; current Order140/2017 lists OMF48/2June2025 published/effective12June2025 as latest amendment; actual annex3/4/4^1 links observed. Order48body re-read and separate classifier link downloaded; its full text matches current-parent classifier.
source_inconsistencies: Instructions print monthly L period format despite annual Code92(3) and separate unified92(8) route. Current-parent annex4^1 caption says Order95/2020 rather than140/2017; actual enacted Order48point1(3) introduces classifier to140. List describes ISOalpha3 but includes Liberland/LBL and legacy country labels; actual ISO status/portal treatment not certified. JUR recipients share citizenship wording without clarified entity-specific rule.
